intro:
VORONEZH (22 OCTOBER 1919)

Comrade Commander! Come quickly, we must act swiftly. Let me introduce you. I am the political commissar attached to your command. The capitalist swine's are close to crushing our glorious revolution! The Great War is over but the war for communism is still in its early phase. We have overthrown the Tsar but that has not stopped the capitalists, monarchists and other enemies of the people to unite, raise forces and march on our people's republic! Petrograd lies under attack and Siberia is under enemy control. Now from the Ukraine a certain traitor named Denikin is directing his army towards our capital of Moscow!

But we are not defeated yet! While the White armies of Denikin march north, their front becomes wider and wider. Our Eight Army has just now lost the city of Voronezh at the Don River. However the army is still intact and resumes fighting. Reinforcements from Moscow are on their way as we speak! Your newly formed command of the First Cavalry Army has been ordered to move out and attack Voronezh from the west. Indeed comrade, you will be cutting through their flank like a knife through butter!

Do not stop for nothing. Go for your objectives. Make terror your weapon! Liberate the peasants of Voronezh!

briliant.text: What a beautiful day, comrade!  The smell of capitalists fleeing from the people's army is in the air.  Voronezh is liberated but the enemy is not yet fully defeated.  Start the pursuit immediately!

victory.text: What a beautiful day, comrade!  The smell of capitalists fleeing from the people's army is in the air.  Voronezh is liberated but the enemy is not yet fully defeated.  Start the pursuit immediately!

intro:
ROSTOV (6 January 1920)

I bring good news from Moscow, comrade! The leaders are very happy with your progress. The fear of a successful army full of horse warriors is excellent propaganda material. Yet it is not only propaganda! Your army has not been defeated and is close to dealing another crucial blow to the capitalist's cause in southern Russia!

The momentum still lies with our cause! The capitalist armies are ever retreating further south. Your Army has the opportunity to capture the important communication center of Rostov. If we control Rostov the Caucasus will also fall into our hands!

Again, comrade, do not watch your back. Only go for Rostov and do not let your troops be stopped by road blocks or anything else important. It is vital that we capture Rostov before the capitalist swines have the time to reinforce the city!

briliant.text:
Yes, comrade. This is an impressive piece of mobile warfare! You were even faster in Rostov than some of the capitalist's troops! Roam the countryside and liberate the towns and villages of the provinces from the capitalists and monarchists. They deserve to be free! Hunt down every last traitor of the people!

AFTERMATH:
By the end of 1919 the White armies in Siberia, western Russia and the Ukraine had been contained and defeated by the victorious Red Army. Although isolated troops and bands continued to roam around, the only organized resistance was put up by General Wrangel on the Crimea. However, with peace so close by for the Bolshevik government, the tide seemed to turn again and not for the better...

intro:
BATTLE OF VOLODARKA (29 May 1920)

Comrade, finally all of your command has arrived at the new front in the west. The front against the Poles! The newly emerged Polish state has invaded our sacred territory both in the Belarus as here in the Ukraine. Kiev has fallen into Polish hands already but again the enemy is widespread and this offers chances to turn the tide!

Your force will assemble south of Kiev and attack the Polish positions well south of Kiev. Your goal will be to force a way through the Polish line and open up a gap so we can pour in infantry and cut off the enemy at Kiev. Your operation will be supported by the 3rd Don Cossack Brigade which is few days march behind you.

briliant.text:
Comrade, the operation near Volodarka has not been a success. The Polish troops had cowardly tactics and hid themselves in the villages where our horses have little effect! However the fighting with the Polish cavalry showed that the people's Cavalry Army is a superior army!

There is more bad news. The reason why you lost contact with the Don Cossacks Brigade was not your fault, comrade. It seems that they have switched sides and have joined the capitalist criminals that we are fighting! I urge you to make clear to your men the fate of such traitors!

intro:
KIEV COUNTEROFFENSIVE (9 June 1920)

The Revolution is on its way to the West! Comrade, a major offensive by our armies north and south of Kiev has pushed back the Polish bandits. Even blind people can see that Kiev is about to fall. Or better said, given back to the people of Kiev!

Your Cavalry Army has taken part of the push south of Kiev and is now in excellent position to cut off the capitalist's troops still in Kiev. The Twelfth Army is approaching Kiev from the east. The Polish criminals have no respect for the property of the Kiev people and are likely to demolish the bridges and perhaps even more! You are ordered to liberate Kiev, and join up with Twelfth Army and advance as far as you can to the west!

briliant.text:
Comrade! Kiev is liberated! Imagine the headline of tomorrow's newspaper! "The Ukrainian capital has been liberated!" The people of the Ukraine are now free from the capitalists who have ruled them for the past few weeks.

Also, I assume you know what to do with the Ukrainian prisoners of war? They are traitors of their own people. They allied themselves with the very power that invaded their country and they deserve nothing but the final penalty.

intro:
DELAY AT ROVNO (1 July 1920)

No, comrade, you do have to worry about your food supply. Take anything from the country as you go. The people will help you and if they do not it is because they are still terrified of repressions by the capitalist pigs. Now let us go back to our plan of operations, comrade.

After our success at Kiev, the entire front in the Ukraine is moving west. And still is! The Polish armies are far from defeated but they lack the power to stop our people's army for once and for all. While our strategic goal will be Lwow, or Lemberg as the old imperialists from Germany would name it. However the Poles seem to everything to stop them from liberating the people they are oppressing!

You are near Rovno. As always you know what to do. Capture all vital communication centers and push as far west as possible. Most of all let nothing stop you! Like a tornado you must use your mobility. After all it is the symbol for cavalry!

briliant.text:
Do not apologize, comrade. Although you were held up near Rovno, the advance is still under way. Not even the people's army can win every skirmish. But the war, comrade, the war is still going on, and it is going in our favor!

I have received more good news. Comrade Tukhachevsky has started a grand offensive in Belarus and is also moving west! Capitalist Poland will suffer dearly for their attack on the people of Russia!

intro:
BATTLE OF BRODY (29 July 1920)

The war is going excellently! The Revolution will soon liberate the rest of Europe and join with other communists all over the continent! But first we must concentrate on capturing Warsaw in the north and Lwow here in the south!

Yesterday your forces captured the town of Brody. Your pursuit of the Polish Army has left them shattered and desperately awaiting reserves. Let them tremble under the hooves of your horses!

briliant.text:
You have fended off disaster, comrade. The Poles conducted a flanking attack on Brody while our eyes were pointed only on getting to Lwow. You stabilized the situation!

On the other side, it was sarcastic that you had to encounter the treacherous Don Cossacks again that left our side at Volodarka. If they had only known that the Revolution cannot be turned around. We will make sure they know now.

Keep advancing towards Lwow. It is not far now!

intro:
BATTLE OF ZADWORZE (17 August 1920)

Comrade, let me quote something for the French socialist newspaper "L'Humanite" from early August. "Not a man, not a soul, not a shell for reactionary and capitalist Poland. Long live the Russian Revolution! Long live the Workmen's International!" As you can see our struggle against the capitalists is not going unnoticed. The eyes of the socialists all over the world are upon us!

Now back to the battle situation, comrade! There will be time for rejoicing after our victory is certain! I know I have been saying this for days but Lwow is now really within our grasp. We stand some 50 kilometers from Lwow and it appears that there is little between us and the city. However we cannot take a city, always a very hostile terrain for cavalry, without infantry support and better supply. Hence, it is vital that we capture the railroad junction of Zadworze. What the capitalists can gather to resist, I cannot tell. What I can tell is that within days we will be marching into Lwow!

briliant.text: Well, if you like to see it that way.  The Poles were brave for defending that village to the bitter end but it turned into a Polish Thermopylae.  It only shows the superiority of the people's army!  The capitalists from London, Paris and Warsaw are sending their slaves to a certain death in order to stop us.  Yet they fail in stopping us!  They only slowed us down for a single day.  What is a single day in a war?  Go comrade, Lwow is ours!

intro:
LWOW (20 August 1920)

Comrade there lays the old city of Lwow. It was the goal of the Tsar in 1914, Brusilov in 1916 and our goal in 1920. The goal of the Revolution!

Our Red Army is closing in on the city from the north and east. Do I have to tell you about the instructions from Moscow? They are expecting the Red Flag of the Revolution in Lwow as soon as possible! Divisions of our Fourteenth Army are closely following your cavalry. Polish resistance is unknown although interrogations have reported that the Poles bought time at Zadworze for defensive and offensive operations. I believe these are capitalistic and criminal lies imprinted on the Polish soldiers.

Go, comrade, liberate Lwow!!!

briliant.text: For three days blood was shed and both sides have suffered massive casualties.  Lwow is still in reactionary hands.  You have done well despite the results, comrade.  But reports I am getting show a very, very grave situation is on our hands...

intro:
BATTLE OF KOMAROW (29 August 1920)

I have some bad news, comrade. A few days ago while you were busy trying to capture Lwow; the Polish imperialists started a counteroffensive pushing through the center of the line between Lwow and Warsaw. After their breakthrough they turned north and now the entire northern command is retreating in order not to be encircled! Our dreams of capturing Warsaw have to be shelved!

Your cavalry is needed north! If you sweep northwards and cut into the right flank of the Polish offensive we might again turn the tide and Poland will be liberated from their reactionary capitalists!

The Poles have been able to form some kind of defensive line while you were pulling back from the Lwow operation. However, this is no reason to be worried. I am talking about the Cavalry Army! It has not been defeated for months and just saying the name strikes terror into the enemy! Strike north, and join up with our people's army in the north!!!

briliant.text:
Here, quickly, comrade! A squadron of our loyal Cossacks have made a corridor through which we can escape! Though not mauled, we have suffered a moral defeat from the Polish cavalry. Worst of all, we have been denied access to the north and our entire front in Poland is rapidly collapsing...

NOTEWORTHY: Because of the numbers of forces involved, the Battle of Komarow is considered the greatest cavalry battle of the 20th century. Also it was the last battle fought mostly by cavalry units, in which traditional cavalry tactics were used and sabers and lances played a vital role.

intro:
RETREAT FROM ROVNO (18 September 1920)

Comrade have I ever told you why I joined the Bolshevik party? No, but you are right. There is no time for such tales. I have noticed it, comrade. Morale is low among the ranks. The sudden change in the course of the war has left its traces. This is a serious set back. But it is merely a set back!

The Northern armies will have to retreat on their own to defensive positions while we prepare to strike again and then finally make the wishes of millions of proletarians come true! In the south it has been quieter but it seems the imperialists in Warsaw have gathered enough men to continue the counteroffensive in the south as well.

There is no hope of stopping the monarchists now but we will not fall into enemy hands. We will retreat, reorganize and make the Polish capitalists pay for this! The Revolution will not be tamed! Make your way east, comrade, the town of Rovno has fallen into the dirty hands of the enemy! Retreat!

briliant.text:
Our armies are safe, comrade. Thanks to your excellent rearguard duty slowing down the Polish army in the south long enough for us to retreat to better positions. The front is stabilizing again locally. Plus I have orders for our command to be pulled out of the frontline. That means rest and refitting for the first time in months!

---Some weeks later at the local HQ---

Good news, comrade! The capitalists in Warsaw realize that further struggles with the People's Republic will inevitably will lead their defeat! Though not all of our claims have been recognized in the cease fire, we now have peace at our western borders! That means we finally have a border instead of a front!

Sadly that is not true for the southern border...

intro:
KAKHOVKA (20 October 1920)

That traitor Wrangel still operates like a wolf from the Crimea. He stabbed the people's army in the back while we were occupied with the war against Poland. Now that those reactionaries have seen that the Revolution in Russia cannot be stopped, we can muster all resources to bring peace to Russia! Russia ruled by its people!

Wrangel has broken out of the Crimea some time ago and captured land north of the Perekop isthmus. We can only be grateful for a foolish act like that. His forces are now strung out and have few reserves. The idiots aligning themselves with Wrangel's fate must now even face the Cavalry Army!

Comrade, cross the Dnjepr River near Kakhovka and quickly penetrate through the enemy lines. Their force must not reach the Perekop isthmus before we do if we are to gain an easy victory! The proletariat has suffered enough during the last years!

intro:
PEREKOP (28 October 1920)

Quickly, comrade. We have almost made it to the Perekop isthmus. If those Tsarists are willing to make a stand against the glorious people of Russia then they will do it there!

While other armies are mopping up enemy criminals that have been encircled, all of the remaining people's army not occupied with that task is being directed to the Perekop isthmus. They will be placed under your command as soon as they arrive in the region, comrade! In Moscow they regard you as a military genius! The Revolution is driving the proletariat to great acts!

Your horses are the most mobile force that we have, comrade. Dash to the isthmus and force your way into the Crimea!!!

briliant.text: We must not stop now!  We have forced our way over the Perekop isthmus.  Not only is Moscow happy with your results but also the glorious people's army.  Now Wrangel is not in the position to cause more bloodshed.  Blood of the Russian proletariat!  Go forward and hunt down the enemy criminals!

intro:
SEVASTOPOL (11 November 1920)

It all does not matter anymore, comrade. Strategy? We want victory! The Tsarist monarchists know their fate. Their dream of a Russia full of slaves they can control is gone! The people have stood up against this injustice and united itself to drive out the capitalist oppressors!

There are clear signs that the capitalists from London will send the Royal Navy to Russia and attempt to evacuate Wrangel and his forces. Comrade, this shows the lies told by the British and Wrangel. How are they to evacuate a massive army? Most likely they will only bring him and a few others to safety while the rest await the mercy of the glorious people's army!

Now, go forward and hunt down the criminals of the people of Russia before they can get away!

briliant.text: Comrade, this is one of the finest bottles of vodka!  Something that Wrangel wanted to take with him in his escape.  Though Wrangel has escaped, something historical has happened, comrade.  The Revolution of the proletariat in Russia has succeeded!  For the first time in history, the socialists of the people will rule themselves!  No more tyranny, no more social classes!  We will all be equal!  A dream has come alive, comrade!
